chunks: Al-Riḍā عليه السلام said: “O so-and-so, when the time enters for you, then perform the two prayers, for you do not know what may happen.”
120 - Muḥammad ibn Aḥmad ibn Yaḥyā, from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥusayn, from Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā ibn Ḥabīb, who said:
I wrote to Abī al-Ḥasan al-Riḍā عليه السلام: supererogatory salat (prayer) remains due from me; when should I make it up?
So he wrote: “At whatever hour you wish, by night or by day.”

key_terms.أَقْضِيهَا: I make it up after its time has passed
key_terms.ٱلصَّلَاةُ ٱلنَّافِلَةُ: supererogatory salat (prayer) beyond what is obligatory

ai.seo_question: When can missed nafilah salat (prayer) be made up according to Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This report conveys guidance from Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام concerning the timely performance of salat (prayer) and the making up of missed nafilah prayers. It indicates urgency in performing prayer when its time enters and permits making up supererogatory salat (prayer) at any hour of the night or day.
